short-form.name: Short-form vertical (Reels / TikTok / Shorts)
short-form.captions: Big bold word-by-word captions, centered lower third, highlight key words
short-form.music: Trending or upbeat track at -20 dB under voice, beat-synced cuts
short-form.transitions: Hard cuts, punch-in zooms (110-120%), whoosh on scene change
structure: First 1-3 seconds. Bold claim, question, or visual surprise. No intro.
Why this matters to the viewer, in one sentence.
The tips / story / steps. One idea per shot.
Result or punchline, then follow / comment prompt. Loop back to the hook if possible.

talking-head.name: Talking-head YouTube
talking-head.captions: Optional full subtitles (.srt) plus on-screen text for key points
talking-head.music: Low lo-fi or ambient bed at -25 dB, drop out for emphasis
talking-head.transitions: Jump cuts to remove pauses, alternate 100% / 115% framing every few cuts
talking-head.color: Natural skin tones, light contrast boost
structure: Promise the outcome in the first 15 seconds.
Who you are and why to trust you. Keep it short.
3-5 sections, each with a B-roll or graphic insert.
Subscribe prompt, next video suggestion, end screen (last 20 s).

vlog.name: Vlog / day-in-the-life
vlog.captions: Minimal, location / time labels, occasional funny text pop-ups
vlog.music: Multiple tracks per chapter, louder in B-roll montages
vlog.transitions: J-cuts and L-cuts, match cuts, occasional speed ramps
structure: Best or most interesting moment of the day as a teaser.
Quick title card and what today is about.
Chronological chunks, each with a montage moment.
Talk to camera about how the day went.

tutorial.name: Tutorial / screencast
tutorial.captions: Full subtitles, step numbers on screen, highlight boxes around clicks
tutorial.transitions: Simple cuts, zoom into important screen areas
structure: What the viewer needs before starting.
Numbered steps, one action per step, show then explain.
Recap and where to go next.

cinematic.name: Cinematic B-roll / montage
cinematic.music: Music-led, edit cuts to the beat and drops
cinematic.transitions: Cuts on beat, speed ramps, whip pans, cross dissolves on slow sections
cinematic.color: Graded look (teal-orange or moody), consistent LUT across shots
structure: Faster cuts, closer shots, energy rising with the music.
Fastest cuts and strongest shots on the music peak.
Slow down, final hero shot, title or logo.
